title: iFuzz-Meta: An Interpretable Fuzzy Learning Framework Bridging Top-Down and Bottom-Up Knowledge Integration
abstract: arXiv:2608.14646v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interpretable representation learning remains a key challenge in modern neural computation, particularly when models are expected not only to perform but also to explain their reasoning. This paper introduces iFuzz-Meta, an interpretable fuzzy rule-based learning framework that preserves human-understandable reasoning structures within modern neural architectures. Each fuzzy rule corresponds to a semantic and spatial prototype defined in the original feature space, enabling transparent inference and direct interpretability. Meta-learning is employed as an analytical paradigm to examine how these interpretable rules reorganize across tasks and domains, providing a principled means to link algorithmic adaptation with cognitive representation. A knowledge-guided regularization mechanism further enables a top-down-bottom-up integration, in which theoretical priors act as soft inductive biases while data-driven learning refines and extends

translated_title: iFuzz-Meta：一种连接自上而下与自下而上知识整合的可解释模糊学习框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14646v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：可解释的表示学习仍然是现代神经计算中的一个关键挑战，特别是当模型不仅需要执行任务，还要解释其推理过程时。本文介绍了iFuzz-Meta，一种可解释的基于模糊规则的学习框架，它在现代神经架构中保留了人类可理解的推理结构。每条模糊规则对应于原始特征空间中定义的语义和空间原型，从而实现透明的推理和直接的可解释性。元学习被用作一种分析范式，以检查这些可解释规则如何在任务和领域之间重组，提供了一种将算法适应与认知表示联系起来的原则性方法。一种知识引导的正则化机制进一步实现了自上而下与自下而上的整合，其中理论先验作为软归纳偏差，而数据驱动的学习则完善并扩展了这些偏差。
tldr: 本文提出了iFuzz-Meta框架，通过将模糊规则与元学习及知识引导正则化相结合，实现了神经模型中的可解释推理和跨任务知识整合。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes iFuzz-Meta, a framework that integrates fuzzy rules with meta-learning and knowledge-guided regularization to enable interpretable reasoning and cross-task knowledge integration in neural models.
